headline: Router metrics add verb label and longrunning watch gauge
reason: Changes the label set of an existing histogram and registers a new metric, which can break dashboards, alerts and series cardinality.
risk_signals: metric label set changed on existing histogram
summary: The duration histogram gains a verb label (group, verb, status_code), a new grafana_router_longrunning_requests{group} gauge is registered, and help texts now say watches are excluded. Existing queries that aggregate or match on the old label set see different series, and the verb label value comes from client-controlled request data.
focus: Dashboards, alerts or recording rules using http_request_duration_seconds that assume the old label set
Whether the verb label values are bounded for arbitrary client HTTP methods
Registration of the new gauge does not collide with other collectors on the same registry

issues.title: Verb label can take unbounded client-chosen values
issues.evidence: WithLabelValues(metricGroup, verb, strconv.Itoa(rec.status)); requestVerb: return strings.ToLower(req.Method)
issues.failure_scenario: A client sends requests with many distinct HTTP method tokens (e.g. FOO1, FOO2, ...) to a non-resource path such as /apis/<group>; each unique method creates a new native-histogram series per group and status code, growing memory, even though unknown groups are collapsed to a single label to prevent exactly this.
